title: The cryptofication of JD Vance
content:
Memes mocking Vice President J. D. Vance have gone viral online, giving him an endless string of bizarre digital makeovers as a chubby-cheeked, childish kid with a lollipop, spinning propeller hats, and a Willy Wonka-inspired blueberry transformation. The memes escalated dramatically after Vance’s tense Oval Office exchange with Ukraine's President Zelensky.

Unlike typical political memes meant to ridicule opponents, these edits appeal to both liberals and conservatives. Interestingly, right-wing meme creators who are normally staunch Vance supporters, have been eagerly participating and the vice president himself attempted to get in on the action by posting his own edit. Some on the right believe that the memes set the stage for a future "inevitable presidency" by inserting Vance into pop culture and inoculating him from attacks.

However, no one has capitalized on the meme more than the crypto community. As of today, the primary crypto meme coin based on the meme has a market cap of $34 million, I sat down with the man who started the entire meme, L.A. resident Dave McNamee, to chat with him about how the meme got started and how his life has been upended by the crypto to meme hype cycle.
